intro:
Welcome to our comprehensive review and strategy guide for "What that Picture" by GamePix, a kids browser game that has captured the hearts of many young puzzle enthusiasts. This game stands out in the ever-growing world of kids' puzzle apps with its simplicity, charm, and endless fun. If you're a parent looking for a game that's both entertaining and safe for your little ones, or simply a player looking to challenge your problem-solving skills, this review will guide you through the world of "What that Picture". 

The game is an unassuming yet addictive puzzle game that invites players to guess the correct image before the picture completely unravels. With 90 different pictures to explore, a 2D cute graphic style, great audio effects, and a super simple gameplay mechanic, this game is perfect for kids and kids-at-heart. The controls are intuitive, allowing players to use their mouse, keyboard, or touch controls to play. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the world of puzzle games, "What that Picture" is sure to captivate and challenge you.

But what makes this game truly special? In this review, we'll delve into the core gameplay mechanics, addictive features, visual style and atmosphere, beginner tips and tricks, advanced strategies, game modes and features, and who should play this game. By the end of this review, you'll be equipped with the knowledge to tackle even the toughest puzzles and unlock the full potential of "What that Picture".

So, buckle up, puzzle enthusiasts, and get ready to uncover the magic of "What that Picture"!

sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The game's core mechanic is incredibly simple: the player is presented with a scrambled image, and they must guess the correct picture before the entire image unravels. Sounds easy, right? But what makes this game challenging is the decreasing time limit as the game progresses. The faster you solve the puzzles, the higher your score will be. But be warned, the game gets progressively harder as you progress through the levels, and the images become increasingly distorted.

One of the key aspects of the game is the use of color and pattern recognition. Players must use their observation skills to identify the colors, shapes, and patterns in the image, and then use that information to make an educated guess. The game also rewards players for accuracy, providing a satisfying sense of accomplishment when they solve a puzzle correctly.

Another essential aspect of the game is its use of visual cues. The game uses visual effects to indicate when the player is close to solving the puzzle, making it easier for them to make educated guesses. Additionally, the game provides feedback in the form of sound effects and visual animations, which helps to create a fun and engaging experience.

Overall, the game's core mechanics are well-designed and engaging, making it perfect for kids and adults alike.
